'''Reog''' was the leader of the [[Reog's Regiment]], one of the larger independent [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His regiment struck a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility in a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] system, but [[Lorka]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], hired a rival mercenary fleet to attack reog's fleet in retaliation. He and his regiment were then hired by [[Grruna Thu]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] leader of the [[Shrook Clan]], to attack the [[Hakks]], a rival clan, in retaliation for destroying their outpost on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. The mercenaries were ultimately overwhelmed in the battle.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
